items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid, volumes go to the right pipette (p300 for 40–200 µL), and the wells stay under 360 µL (max 290). Labware matches the spec and all checks pass.
The move() helper picks up a fresh tip for every transfer and always calls drop_tip(). The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks passed.
All 13 steps appear in order with the right volumes, 10x mixes after beads and water, and protocol.comment for each manual step. Nothing extra is added.
move(40, beads, well, mix_reps=10, mix_vol=40) runs for all 96 wells, then the 5 min incubation comment is recorded before the magnet comment.
The magnet-engage and wait comment is recorded. 90 µL goes from each well to waste, then two 200 µL ethanol add and removal passes run for all 96 wells.
The 5 min air-dry comment and the magnet-disengage comment come first. Then 50 µL water is added with a 10x mix, and the 2 min incubation plus re-engage comment follows.
zip(samples, eluates) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the matching elution plate well, and the end_state:elution_plate check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows every step in the task: bead binding with mixing, supernatant removal, two ethanol washes, elution with mixing, and recovery to the matching elution plate wells. It uses a fresh tip for each transfer, records the manual steps with comments, and passed all measured checks.
